bugs.error_message: AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED after a full-evidence report request
bugs.root_cause: A single request shared the model context between all evidence and the long generated response.
bugs.fix: Process whole fragments in sequential per-model character-bounded batches, accept oversized fragments alone, validate strictly and combine exact duplicates before one PDF publication.

bugs.error_message: Mypy rejected report section keys and an optional usage object during batch implementation
bugs.root_cause: Untyped section constants widened literal keys to str; repeated dictionary lookups did not narrow optional usage.
bugs.fix: Type SECTIONS as a tuple of Section literals and narrow a single raw_usage local before reading token counts; explicit mypy passes.
